title: Rabbit's Foot Owner Hub competitive benchmark

method.cohort: Five established field-service and contractor apps with current U.S. Apple App Store listings and official product documentation.
method.ownerHubReview: Static inspection of the Owner Hub source tree and data models after the 2.4.1 release build.
method.ratingCaveat: App Store ratings are point-in-time public sentiment signals, not a complete measure of product quality, and may change after this snapshot.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Internal-test release with error boundaries, startup diagnostics, offline storage, and a cloud retry queue; production crash, sync, and API observability is not yet evident in the client source.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: Mature apps continuously ship bug and performance fixes and support large public user bases.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Add crash reporting, API and sync telemetry, attachment-upload diagnostics, in-app beta feedback, automated backup/restore verification, and staged release gates.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Lead inbox, customer records, Customer Hub, and manual SMS/email actions exist; public self-booking and provider-backed automatic reminders and follow-ups are not evident.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: Jobber, Housecall Pro, and Workiz promote online booking, automated reminders, estimate follow-ups, and review requests.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Add public booking/intake, automatic confirmations and reminders, estimate follow-up sequences, review requests, delivery status, opt-out handling, and push notifications.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Owner/admin/technician roles and job time entries exist, but appointments have no technician assignment and time entries have no member identity; GPS routing and live ETA are not evident.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: Leading field-service suites assign technicians, dispatch work, track time by employee, and provide route or location visibility.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Add technician assignment, dispatch board, crew-specific time entries, on-my-way status, route/ETA support, job checklists, and an audit log.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Square is implemented; QuickBooks and Google Calendar are represented in integration types and database constraints but no end-user connection workflow is evident.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: QuickBooks sync and calendar integrations are standard expansion features across leading platforms.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Finish QuickBooks Online and Google Calendar integrations with explicit sync direction, reconciliation, error recovery, and duplicate protection.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: AI estimates produce direct labor cost, material cost, duration, and historical comparisons without hidden markup or overhead.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: Competitors emphasize fast quoting, pricebooks, optional upgrades, and AI-assisted office work.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Keep the simple direct-cost philosophy, add owner feedback on accepted or corrected estimates, show historical evidence, and measure estimate-to-actual accuracy by job type.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Receipt capture, AI field drafting, reviewed save, categories for materials, gas, and vehicle parts, job linking, image download/print/share, CSV export, and dashboard totals are implemented.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: Expense tracking exists in broader platforms, but receipt-first owner workflows are not their primary public positioning.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Turn this into a signature advantage with duplicate detection, tax-ready monthly exports, vendor normalization, mileage logs, and receipt-to-estimate variance alerts.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Material checklists and receipt-linked job expenses exist; purchase orders, vendor records, stock quantities, and reorder alerts are not evident.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: Workiz advertises inventory management, while ServiceTitan supports parts ordering and broader purchasing workflows.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Add lightweight vendors, purchase orders, ordered/picked-up/returned states, and frequently used material lists before attempting full warehouse inventory.

capabilityAssessment.ownerHubState: Dashboard totals, job profitability, pricing history, and AI operations exist; cross-funnel conversion, crew performance, cash-flow forecasting, and custom reporting are limited.
capabilityAssessment.marketPattern: The largest platforms compete on operational and financial reporting.
capabilityAssessment.recommendation: Add lead-to-estimate-to-job-to-payment funnel metrics, labor and material variance, aging receivables, repeat-customer rate, and estimate win rate.
